_note: Swept-surface D2 samples and point projections, recorded from the independent reference kernel. Extrusion: S(u, v) = profile(u) + v * direction (unit). Revolution: S(u, v) = the profile point at v turned by the angle u about the axis. Each projection's distance was checked against a dense sampling of the search window, and no closest point lies on that window's edge.

extrusions.name: circle in a plane holding the direction (a folded strip)
parabola with its axis along the direction

revolutions.name: ellipse meridian far from the axis, queried beside the axis
line parallel to the axis (a cylinder)
rational Bézier meridian about a tilted axis
